description:
"BEYBLADE X XONE" is not available for purchase as the base game only. Please purchase the bundle, "BEYBLADE X XONE & Season Pass", which includes the season pass for free.

Get ready to have a blast, because the game adaptation of BEYBLADE X is here!
 Experience action-packed BEYBLADE battles in a stadium equipped with BEYBLADE X's signature X-celerator Rail as you unleash the Xtreme Dash and use the game's original "Active Gauge".
 
 ■STORY
 A new tournament, The X Championship, is being held at The X.
 Compete against rivals and strengthen bonds as you aim for the top of The X!
 
 ■BATTLE
 Feel the impact of extreme acceleration in the stadium equipped with the X-celerator Rail.
 Unleash critical "Attacks" and "Counters" one after another,
 then use the "X Skill" to blow your opponent away in style!
 
 ■CUSTOMIZE
 Customization takes X Skills into account and offers over 100 million possible combinations!
 Freely combine parts and skills to set up your Bey just the way you want.
 
 ■ONLINE BATTLES
 In online battles, you can compete against Bladers from all corners of the globe anytime, anywhere!
 Compete with Bladers from around the world and aim for the top.
name: BEYBLADE X XONE
intro: Enjoy thrilling and extreme video game battles!
